children: Anand, who served as AVP and Vertical Head – Corporate Affairs, Corporate Communication & Social, was associated with Hyundai Motor India for 28 years, 10 months and six days

Puneet Anand, AVP and Vertical Head - Corporate Affairs, Corporate Communication & Social at Hyundai Motor India, has announced his exit from the company after a tenure of 28 years, 10 months and six days.
Announcing his departure through a LinkedIn post, Anand said he would be taking time to reflect and recharge before moving on to his next chapter.

Anand's nearly three-decade association with Hyundai saw him take up responsibilities across several functions, including Customer Care and CRM, Marketing and Sales, Corporate Communication, Corporate Affairs and Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). His roles also involved brand-building initiatives, marketing innovations and public policy engagement.

During his tenure, Anand witnessed and contributed to several important developments in Hyundai's India operations. These included the launch of the Santro, the establishment of the company's second manufacturing plant in Chennai, its five-millionth and 10-millionth vehicle rollouts, and the introduction of the Creta, which became one of Hyundai's key models in the Indian SUV market.
He was also associated with Hyundai's acquisition and inauguration of its third manufacturing facility in Talegaon, Maharashtra.

Anand also highlighted his association with Hyundai Motor Company's headquarters in South Korea, having travelled to Seoul more than 26 times during his career. He completed his postgraduate studies in South Korea, an experience he credited with contributing significantly to his professional growth.

Reflecting on his departure, Anand thanked the company's leadership, colleagues, dealers, suppliers and business partners for their support throughout his career. He said the relationships he built and the teams he worked with remained his most valued achievements. He did not disclose details of his next professional assignment.
